name: 婴幼儿彩棉开衫内衣款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的主图
一秒传达彩棉织纹与贴身舒适的核心卖点
放大套头衫穿脱麻烦的痛点，引出按扣开衫的解法
用微距证明圆领包边与按扣的做工细节
并列双配色让买家自选，展示色系跨度
代入真实居家穿着场景，传递贴身自在
用空白数值行讲清尺码结构，消除买错码疑虑
用缝边细节与空白徽章位降低购买风险
双色并列收口促单，留出行动位

style.backgroundSystem: cloud-white #F4F2F7 and oat-cream #F1E9DC backdrops for packshots and info panels, dark walnut wood #4E382B reserved for macro texture insets
style.iconSystem: simple thin-line badge frames and thin dimension lines, single warm gold accent
style.lightingSystem: soft warm diffused studio lighting, front-left key, gentle shadows, soft contact shadow only, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft gentle baby-underwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-white #F4F2F7, oat-cream #F1E9DC, walnut brown #5A4634 and one warm gold accent #C9A063; soft warm diffused lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; rounded modern sans-serif typography used sparingly; simple thin-line badge and dimension-line style; clean gentle product photography mixed with minimal infographic panels; calm centered composition with stable garment scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: calm centered composition, garment laid flat or hung upright, stable hero angle and scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: round woven rattan mats and matte light boards, dark walnut wood for texture close-ups
